entities.summary: The Finnish Air Force Museum, formerly the Aviation Museum of Central Finland, is an aviation museum located near Jyväskylä Airport in Tikkakoski, Jyväskylä, Finland. The museum exhibits the aviation history of Finland, from the early 1900s until today. The museum is owned by the Foundation of Aviation Museum of Central Finland.
